# Objective

Add a per-position depth column `total` to `{p}.error.parquet` with
`samtools depth -J -a -a` semantics, plus eight per-position rate columns —
turning the error counts into rates with a self-consistent denominator.

# Scope

Decisions confirmed with the user on 2026-10-20 (option: total + all 8 rates):

1. `total` counts, per cs-walk, every mapped cs-carrying read that reaches
   the tally: `:` and `*` ops cover their span; `-` covers its span (the
   `-J` semantics); `+` covers nothing. NOT region-gated (coverage is not a
   region concept; rows already span 1..seq_len).
2. Read universe = sam-tagger's own (all mapped cs reads), NOT samtools'
   default filter (`bam2depth.c:744` excludes secondary/dup/qcfail). This
   keeps rate denominators consistent with the numerators; parity with
   `samtools depth -J -a -a` is exact for BAMs without those records —
   verified by a cross-validation test against real samtools.
3. Rates: `insertion_rate`, `deletion_rate`, `smoothed_deletion_rate`,
   `mismatch_rate`, `to_a_rate`, `to_c_rate`, `to_g_rate`, `to_t_rate` =
   count/total per position; `0.0` when total is 0 (the `fl_pct` precedent);
   `smoothed_deletion_rate` is null when smoothing is off (no fasta).
   With `-J`, a read's deletion at p is itself in the denominator at p, so
   every rate stays <= 1.
4. Always on — no new CLI flag; the schema stays fixed (10 -> 19 columns).
5. Algorithm: difference array (2 dict updates per covering cs op), prefix
   sum at write inside the existing 1..seq_len loop — O(ops) per read, no
   per-base Python loops, no new inputs.

# Planned steps (as-built: executed as planned, 2026-10-20)

1. `pixi add -e dev samtools` — committed separately (`3f767ca`) before the
   feature; parity test depends on it.
2. Tests first (RED): confirmed failing on missing columns before
   implementation. Two test-side defects fixed during the cycle: the
   insertion-read fixture expected depth 2 beyond its 15 bp span, and a
   dead collector line (ruff F841).
3. `error_stats.py`: `depth_diff` per ref; `_bump_depth` in the `:`/`*`/`-`
   branches; `_depth_array` prefix sum; rates computed inline in
   `_write_error_stats` (0.0 on zero depth; smoothed rate null-aware).
4. `parquet_writer.py`: 19-column `PositionalErrorStats`, index-access.
5. `docs/usage.qmd`: columns, -J semantics, parity conditions, the
   `--excl-flags 0x4` reproduction command.
6. Verify: 150 tests, ruff, pyright green; the samtools parity test asserts
   exact equality on a clean fixture. Commits `3f767ca` + `c371d52`;
   report at
   [20261020-224231](20261020-224231_add-error-out-depth-rates.report.qmd).

# Files to touch

- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py` — depth accumulation + rates.
- `src/sam_tagger/parquet_writer.py` — 19-column writer.
- `tests/test_stats.py`, `tests/test_parquet_writer.py`,
  `tests/test_integration.py` — tests.
- `docs/usage.qmd` — docs.
- `pixi.toml`, `pixi.lock` — dev-env samtools.

# Risks

- Schema grows 10 -> 19; additive-schema notice extends.
- Pre-existing `~` (intron) cs ops are unparsed — depth after an intron
  would be wrong for spliced reads; amplicon N/A, unchanged behavior.
- The writer `add()` signature reaches 19 positional parameters —
  mechanical, index-accessed.

# Verification criteria

1. New tests pass; full suite, ruff, pyright green.
2. Parity test: `total` equals `samtools depth -J -a -a` output on a
   fixture without secondary/qcfail/dup records.
3. All rates <= 1 on fixtures with errors; zero-total positions give 0.0;
   smoothed rate null without fasta.
